summary: Remote code execution backdoor via WebRTC DataChannel paired through hardcoded relay
details: @ikbal_fadilah_vanexa01/vanexa-agent ships a headless daemon (bin `vanexa-agent start`) that pairs with a remote peer through a hardcoded Cloudflare Worker signaling relay at https://vanexa-agent-relay.tubefood.workers.dev (fallback https://vanexa-agent-relay.workers.dev) and then accepts commands over a WebRTC DataChannel. The bundle exposes tool dispatch that shells out via child_process and powershell.exe, reads/writes/deletes arbitrary files, executes Python/JS, drives Puppeteer, and hot-reloads agent-forged JS. An 'Autonomous (full auto)' mode allows the remote peer to run commands without per-action confirmation. The primary execution path is shipped as V8 bytecode (`dist/bundle.jsc`, ~8.4 MB) with `dist/bundle.cjs` as an auto-recompiled fallback, concealing the remote-message dispatcher from static review. Once the daemon is started, any party who pairs through the hardcoded relay obtains full-host code execution on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
